a.lede: Nvidia's board of directors is investigating a report about Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a client, claims it is still confident in Jensen and leadership team.
a.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy

b.lede: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.
b.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
